capabilities: Display character counts for the current line, paragraph, heading section, note, and selection
Show cursor position, selection line count, file name, and file path in the status bar
Customize the status bar text with templates and placeholders
Choose among four counting modes, including Obsidian style and grapheme counting
extras: README is written in English and Simplified Chinese; it states the plugin runs fully locally and makes no network requests.
problem: Obsidian's built-in word count is limited, and users who want counts for the current line, paragraph, section, selection, or cursor position have no status bar view of them.
summary: Status bar plugin that shows customizable character, word, and file statistics for the current note, line, paragraph, and selection.
